## Overview Fix `vllm bench serve` failing with HTTP 401 during automatic model discovery when the server requires an API key and the client sets `OPENAI_API_KEY`. Reuse the existing request-header helper for the `/v1/models` lookup. ## Claims - Environment credentials authenticate automatic model discovery as well as generation requests. - Explicit `--header` values retain precedence, and unrelated headers are preserved. - Requests without credentials still fail against an authenticated server. ## Validation Base: `2fb320d8304381e224dd27fbf8c13c30b4e1020f`; fix: `412591366f04abcc2271fcd6879cfa2040db6e9c`. | Check | Before fix | After fix | | --- | --- | --- | | Five CPU argument-parsing/main_async HTTP regression cases | 2 failed, 3 passed (environment-key cases received HTTP 401) | 5 passed | | Main benchmark CLI against real authenticated Qwen3-0.6B service | HTTP 401 during `/v1/models` | 1 completed, 0 failed | | Real service, no client key | Not separately run | HTTP 401 | The targeted CPU test uses real argument parsing, `main_async`, and a loopback HTTP/SSE server. It covers environment credentials, an additional header, explicit Authorization precedence with two header casings, and missing credentials. Validation used Python 3.12.14 / PyTorch 2.14.0+cpu with conftest and plugin loading disabled; CUDA was not initialized. The human submitter ran the actual CLI acceptance check against a vLLM 0.30.0 server with cached real Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B weights on an RTX 4090 (`--enforce-eager`, max model length 1024). The benchmark client came from the baseline/patched main source above. This is cross-version client/server validation. Added a `RemoteOpenAIServer` regression that starts an authenticated server, omits `--model` and auth headers, and checks one completed benchmark request using the environment key. This same-version GPU integration test has not been run locally: the main checkout currently has a client-only installation. The existing Buildkite benchmark job selects both test files. For a full development installation (commands provided for reproduction; the same-version GPU command has not been run locally): ```bash uv run --no-sync pytest -v tests/benchmarks/test_serve_cli_auth.py uv run --no-sync pytest -v tests/benchmarks/test_serve_cli.py::test_bench_serve_model_discovery_with_api_key ``` All configured pre-commit hooks on the four changed files passed, including Ruff, mypy, markdownlint, and Buildkite test tethering. No hooks were bypassed; unrelated file-type hooks were automatically skipped.
CPU-isolated command actually run (5 passed) The client-only environment cannot load the full engine test conftest. From the repository root, after installing the benchmark dependencies: ```bash auth_pytest_config=$(mktemp --suffix=.ini) cat > "$auth_pytest_config" <<'INI' [pytest] markers = benchmark: Benchmark clients skip_global_cleanup: No GPU state INI PYTHONPATH="$PWD" CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu \ HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 \ .venv/bin/python -m pytest --noconftest -c "$auth_pytest_config" \ -v --tb=short tests/benchmarks/test_serve_cli_auth.py rm "$auth_pytest_config" ``` The real-service check invoked the native benchmark CLI with one custom token-ID prompt and one output token, tokenizer initialization skipped, warmups disabled, and no `--model` or auth header. Only `OPENAI_API_KEY` supplied the credential. The lab acceptance helper and logs are outside the PR.
## Details Generation requests already obtain `OPENAI_API_KEY` through `_get_headers()`, introduced by [#33488](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/33488). Automatic discovery previously received only explicitly supplied `--header` values, so it failed before generation when the key was supplied through the environment. Duplicate-work check (2026-10-26 17:46 Asia/Shanghai): no directly matching open PR or issue was found in searches for `get_first_model_from_server`, `OPENAI_API_KEY` with benchmark, model discovery with auth, and benchmark HTTP 401, including inspection of the latest open PRs. The merged helper work in #33488 did not cover model discovery. Merge the existing default headers with the explicit headers in `get_first_model_from_server`, with explicit values taking precedence. This adds two production lines and no dependency or public interface. The change runs during model discovery and does not alter inference execution. Document the credential behavior in the benchmark CLI guide. AI assistance: OpenAI Codex assisted with investigation, implementation, tests, and this description. The human submitter completed the staged-patch review and signed-off commit steps, and ran the real-service acceptance check. ---

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""CPU coverage for automatic benchmark model discovery and authentication."""
+
+import asyncio
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+from aiohttp import web
+from aiohttp.test_utils import TestServer
+
+from vllm.benchmarks.serve import add_cli_args, main_async
+from vllm.utils.argparse_utils import FlexibleArgumentParser
+
+pytestmark = [pytest.mark.benchmark, pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "environment_key,explicit_header",
+    [
+        pytest.param("test-key", None, id="environment-key"),
+        pytest.param(
+            "test-key", "X-Trace=auth-test", id="environment-key-with-extra-header"
+        ),
+        pytest.param(
+            "wrong-key", "Authorization=Bearer test-key", id="explicit-header-wins"
+        ),
+        pytest.param(
+            "wrong-key", "authorization=Bearer test-key", id="lowercase-header-wins"
+        ),
+        pytest.param(None, None, id="missing-key"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_bench_serve_authenticated_model_discovery(
+    tmp_path: Path,
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    environment_key: str | None,
+    explicit_header: str | None,
+) -> None:
+    """Model discovery must use the same credentials as generation requests."""
+    for name in ("HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY"):
+        monkeypatch.delenv(name, raising=False)
+        monkeypatch.delenv(name.lower(), raising=False)
+    for name in ("NO_PROXY", "no_proxy"):
+        monkeypatch.setenv(name, "127.0.0.1,localhost,::1")
+    monkeypatch.delenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", raising=False)
+    if environment_key is not None:
+        monkeypatch.setenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", environment_key)
+    dataset_path = tmp_path / "requests.jsonl"
+    dataset_path.write_text(
+        json.dumps({"prompt": [1, 2, 3], "output_tokens": 1}) + "\n"
+    )
+    seen: list[tuple[str, str | None]] = []
+    trace_headers: list[str | None] = []
+
+    async def handler(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+        authorization = request.headers.get("Authorization")
+        seen.append((request.path, authorization))
+        trace_headers.append(request.headers.get("X-Trace"))
+        if authorization != "Bearer test-key":
+            return web.json_response({"error": "Unauthorized"}, status=401)
+        if request.path == "/v1/models":
+            return web.json_response(
+                {"data": [{"id": "test-model", "root": "test-model"}]}
+            )
+        assert (await request.json())["model"] == "test-model"
+        chunks = [
+            {"choices": [{"text": "ok", "finish_reason": "length"}]},
+            {"choices": [], "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 3, "completion_tokens": 1}},
+        ]
+        stream = "".join(f"data: {json.dumps(chunk)}\n\n" for chunk in chunks)
+        return web.Response(
+            text=stream + "data: [DONE]\n\n", content_type="text/event-stream"
+        )
+
+    async def run() -> None:
+        app = web.Application()
+        app.router.add_get("/v1/models", handler)
+        app.router.add_post("/v1/completions", handler)
+        async with TestServer(app) as server:
+            parser = FlexibleArgumentParser()
+            add_cli_args(parser)
+            command = [
+                "--base-url",
+                str(server.make_url("/")).rstrip("/"),
+                "--backend",
+                "openai",
+                "--dataset-name",
+                "custom",
+                "--dataset-path",
+                str(dataset_path),
+                "--skip-tokenizer-init",
+                "--skip-chat-template",
+                "--num-prompts",
+                "1",
+                "--num-warmups",
+                "0",
+                "--disable-tqdm",
+                "--ready-check-timeout-sec",
+                "2",
+            ]
+            if explicit_header is not None:
+                command += ["--header", explicit_header]
+            args = parser.parse_args(command)
+            if environment_key is None and explicit_header is None:
+                with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="401"):
+                    await asyncio.wait_for(main_async(args), timeout=15)
+                assert seen == [("/v1/models", None)]
+            else:
+                result = await asyncio.wait_for(main_async(args), timeout=15)
+                assert result["completed"] == 1
+                assert result["failed"] == 0
+                assert seen[0] == ("/v1/models", "Bearer test-key")
+                assert any(path == "/v1/completions" for path, _ in seen)
+                assert all(header == "Bearer test-key" for _, header in seen)
+                if explicit_header == "X-Trace=auth-test":
+                    assert all(header == "auth-test" for header in trace_headers)
+
+    asyncio.run(run())
